rules.headline: If you have chest pain, call 911 now.
rules.action: Chest pain can be a sign of a medical emergency. Call 911 (or your local emergency number) right away.

rules.headline: If you are struggling to breathe, call 911 now.
rules.action: Difficulty breathing can be a medical emergency. Call 911 (or your local emergency number) right away.

rules.headline: If you notice stroke warning signs, call 911 now.
rules.action: Sudden face drooping, arm weakness, or trouble speaking can be signs of a stroke. Call 911 (or your local emergency number) right away.
phrases: went weak for a few minutes

rules.headline: For severe bleeding or a serious injury, call 911 now.
rules.action: Heavy bleeding that will not stop, or a serious injury, needs emergency care. Call 911 (or your local emergency number).

rules.headline: For a severe allergic reaction, call 911 now.
rules.action: Swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or throat with trouble breathing can be a medical emergency. Call 911 (or your local emergency number) right away.

rules.headline: If someone is unresponsive or having a seizure, call 911 now.
rules.action: Loss of consciousness, an unresponsive person, or a first-time or prolonged seizure needs emergency care. Call 911 (or your local emergency number).

rules.headline: If you are thinking about harming yourself, help is available right now.
rules.action: You can reach the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline by calling or texting 988 in the US, 24 hours a day. If you are in immediate danger, call 911 or your local emergency number. You deserve support from a real person, not an app.

rules.headline: For sudden vision loss, get emergency care now.
rules.action: Sudden loss of vision, or sudden double vision, needs urgent assessment. Call 911 (or your local emergency number), or go to an emergency department.
phrases: curtain came down over my eye
part of my vision is gone
part of my vision has gone

rules.headline: These symptoms need emergency care now.
rules.action: A stiff neck with fever, a rash that does not fade when pressed, or confusion with a high fever needs emergency assessment. Call 911 (or your local emergency number).

rules.headline: For a fever in a baby, get medical help now.
rules.action: A fever in a newborn or young infant needs urgent medical assessment. Call 911 (or your local emergency number), or contact your doctor immediately.

rules.headline: These pregnancy symptoms need emergency care now.
rules.action: Bleeding or severe abdominal pain during pregnancy needs urgent assessment. Call 911 (or your local emergency number), or contact your maternity unit immediately.
phrases: severe pain and i am pregnant
severe abdominal pain and i am pregnant
severe one-sided pain and i am pregnant

rules.headline: For a suspected overdose or poisoning, get emergency help now.
rules.action: Call 911 (or your local emergency number). In the US you can also reach Poison Control at 1-800-222-1222, 24 hours a day.
